reason: I look up everyone on Google and Trustpilot before I even message them, and a company in Kuwait with no UK office and no past clients gives me nothing to check. Paying half up front by PayPal to someone I can't look up feels like a gamble I can't afford.
objection: No reviews and no past work to show, so if it goes wrong I've lost half my money to a firm overseas I can't chase. It's good that I'd own my site, but I still worry about the monthly extras creeping up after launch.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews on Google or Trustpilot from UK small businesses I could actually contact, plus being able to pay by bank transfer with a smaller deposit.
